Windows.Subtitle
data.value: Windows tucked behind a screen edge. Hover the tab on the edge to peek, click it to use the window.

data.name: Windows.Paused
data.value: Paused: gesture and rules are off

data.name: Windows.Empty
data.value: Press Ctrl+Win+Alt+→ or drag a window past the edge of the screen.

data.name: Rules.Subtitle
data.value: A program with a rule tucks itself to its edge when its window opens. Make one from a tab's menu or the Windows page.

data.name: Rules.Empty
data.value: No rules yet. Right-click a tab and choose "Always tuck … here".

data.name: Settings.SlideOut
data.value: Slide out after hovering the tab

data.name: Settings.SlideIn
data.value: Slide back after the mouse leaves

data.name: Settings.Gesture
data.value: Drag past the edge to tuck

data.name: Settings.Gesture.Note
data.value: Left, right and bottom edges; this much of the window must be behind the edge

data.name: Settings.Fullscreen
data.value: Hide tabs while a fullscreen app is in front

data.name: Settings.Fullscreen.Note
data.value: Games and fullscreen video: tabs on that monitor disappear, a peeking window slides back

data.name: Toast.TooLong

data.name: Toast.TooBig
data.value: The window is larger than the screen.

data.name: Toast.Admin
data.value: The window runs as administrator: Edge Tuck cannot move it.

data.name: Toast.Refused
data.value: The window would not move, so it stays where it is.

data.name: Toast.Fights
data.value: The window keeps moving itself, so it is back on screen.

data.name: Toast.MonitorsChanged
data.value: Monitors changed: {0} window(s) returned to the screen.

data.name: Toast.FirstRule
data.value: Rules work while Edge Tuck runs. Turn on Start with Windows in Settings.

data.name: Lost.Restart
data.value: Start Edge Tuck again: it brings the windows back by itself.

data.name: Lost.Keys
data.value: Or pick the window with Alt+Tab and press Win+← or Win+→.

data.name: Lost.Move
data.value: Or press Alt+Space → Move, press an arrow key and move the mouse.

data.name: Toast.NoLongerFits
data.value: The window grew and no longer fits on the free part of the edge, so it is back on screen.

data.value: Slide out when the mouse rests on a tab

data.value: Off: a tab opens by click only

data.value: Tabs on edges shared with another monitor

data.value: The window waits behind an outer edge and appears at once; the tab opens by click
